release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.20 restores the owner Announcements bar on fresh WebView2 UI profiles while preserving the v0.45.19 black-screen recovery. The announcement runtime could query /api/license/status before owner broadcast capabilities were fully hydrated, or attach its Owner Vault visibility observer before the Vault element existed, leaving the hub hidden for the session even though Owner Vault later appeared. This release adds bounded capability rechecks, reauthorizes immediately when Owner Vault becomes visible, waits boundedly for late Owner Vault composition, and prevents overlapping authority requests. The narrow app layout-class observer from the Settings -> Appearance freeze fix remains authoritative; no childList/subtree observer is restored. The existing protected /api/owner/broadcasts pipeline, broadcasts.write authority, Top/Classic pairing, Sidebar composer, member announcements, and v0.45.19 data/webview2-ui-v2 recovery profile remain unchanged. The exact PR head passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight including UI/runtime and DOM suites, Windows Consumer E2E including the real Wails/WebView2 shell, and CodeQL before merge and Stable promotion.
